headlines.title: NASA’s LRO Images Falcon 9 Crater on Moon, Learns New Details
headlines.summary: Between Aug. 11 and 12, NASA’s Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) captured a series of images of a new crater on the Moon. The crater formed on Aug. 5, when a SpaceX Falcon 9 upper stage impacted the surface following it
